claim: SNS FIFO topics and SQS FIFO queues provide exactly-once message delivery and processing as long as listed conditions are met; one condition is that the SNS subscription has no message filtering. When you configure message filtering, SNS FIFO topics support at-most-once delivery, as messages can be filtered out based on your subscription filter policies.

evidence.quote: Amazon SNS FIFO topics and Amazon SQS FIFO queues support message deduplication, which provides exactly-once message delivery and processing as long as the following conditions are met:

The Amazon SNS subscription topic has no message filtering. When you configure message filtering, Amazon SNS FIFO topics support at-most-once delivery, as messages can be filtered out based on your subscription filter policies.
